comment.zh: 使用 DataGrip 2023/2024/2025/2026 连接 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle、MongoDB、Redis、Db2 和 ClickHouse。请在 macOS「隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能」中允许 JumpServer。首次连接可能需要下载 JDBC 驱动。
comment.en: Connect to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, Db2 and ClickHouse with DataGrip. Allow JumpServer under macOS Privacy & Security → Accessibility. DataGrip may need to download its JDBC driver on first use.
